_note: Art parameters for the procedural September 1980 basin. Every value here is illustrative and editable; none is a measured width, height, use or crop. Feature ids refer to core-basin-gis.json parent ids (cover fragments '/1', '/2' share their parent's entry).

shangbu-east-west-corridor._note: Cleared corridor; a Shennan works context is a candidate only (place 'shennan'). No carriageway width or completion is claimed.

yard-track-west._note: Representative bundle: illustrative parallel tracks inside the yard envelope, no turnouts.

yard-track-east._note: Representative bundle; no inferred turnout connection.

river-main-west._note: Illustrative width guided by 78–100 m bank-span checks, not a surveyed cross-section.

river-main-east._note: Illustrative compromise; the 74 m shoulder pick need not represent the whole reach.

buji-lower._note: Illustrative low-flow ribbon; the 84 m bank-span hint may include banks or floodplain.

east-bridge-candidate._note: Visible span at the eastern meander. Identification with Wenjindu stays a candidate (place 'wenjindu', gap 'wenjindu-id-unresolved').

west-approach-main-rail.reason: Traced approaches and main railway intersect; grade is a reversible aerial estimate.

west-approach-west-rail.reason: West approach crosses the interpreted western corridor; no surveyed junction or grade.

south-transverse-main-rail.reason: Traced southern approach crosses the main railway; grade is a reversible aerial estimate.

south-transverse-west-rail.reason: Southern approach crosses the interpreted western corridor; no surveyed junction or grade.

south-transverse-buji.reason: Visible paired approaches cross the mapped lower channel; bridge type and dimensions are illustrative.

reservoir._note: Outside the KH-9 window. Outline from the 19 Oct 1979 MSS water mask (lead-level automated observation); level from the modern DSM water surface. No dam or spillway is modelled.
